annotation.title_clean: Towards Trustworthy Physical Intelligence: From Theory to Practice Across the Life Cycle
annotation.title_en: Towards Trustworthy Physical Intelligence: From Theory to Practice Across the Life Cycle
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Yang, W.; Liu, H.; Xu, X.; Menon, A.; Cai, X.; He, Y.; et al.
annotation.summary_en: A survey proposing the T-PAI framework and T-PAIO operationalization for trustworthy physical intelligence (embodied AI, robots, autonomous vehicles). It traces failure propagation across the life cycle and organizes principles (safe operation, human-centered values, privacy and equity, accountability, sustainability) as a basis for governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Existing trustworthy AI frameworks are built for digital AI and miss physical safety, cyber-physical security and manufacturing issues.
Failures propagate across five life cycle stages, so governance must be operationalized at each stage.
Proposes T-PAIO to map governance elements onto life cycle components.
Proposes T-PAI framework with five pillars: robust and safe operation, human-centered values, integrity/privacy/equity, accountability and oversight, sustainability.
Calls for traceability and lineage tracking of robot data, models and deployment decisions.
